$comment: A person's routine (an ordered schedule: each slot from and to HH:MM, on days 0-6 (Monday 0) or every day (null), at a location, doing an activity; a slot may run overnight, from after to), motivations (goals, fears, current intent: a list of text) and invariants (the lines they never cross, "never harms a child": a list of short sentences), checked alike by server/extensions/wiki_shared/Routine.py and client packages/wiki/src/lib/routine.ts. All three kept as JSON text; a campaign's clock counts minutes from day 1, 00:00 (a new one starts at contract clock_start_minutes, day 1 08:00).
